headline: Ouachita Baptist and Rogers State alone stay unbeaten
dek: Ouachita Baptist have won twice without conceding a goal, and Rogers State have won twice with one against. The other five programmes have all lost at least once.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Five different players have scored Ouachita Baptist's six goals, and only Eric Godoy has scored twice.

wire.line: Harding have played once and are still waiting for their first goal of the season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: The season's one score gap is Newman's, away at Cowley: the match is marked final and carries no score. Three more matches are past their date with no result published at all, a separate absence and a separate count.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Every match with a published score also has a box score behind it. The collector reached the detail of each.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's draw with Delta State is the only match this season that a programme in this conference has neither won nor lost.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Tristan Miller has made ten saves for Rogers State and been beaten once.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Both of Southern Nazarene's goals this season are Wesley Rodriguez's.

last_match.line: Ouachita Baptist had scored in each of their earlier matches; Delta State leave with a draw to set beside their win at Harding.

next_match.line: Rockhurst have already lost at Fort Hays State and won at home against Newman; Rogers State arrive unbeaten.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
